name: Gradient
identity_check: Confirmed as Gradient (gradient.com; legal entity GRDNT LLC per its privacy policy), the seed fund for AI founders that Google set up in 2017 and that announced its $220M Fund 5 'as a fully independent firm' on 2026-03-17 (own post; Fortune; Pulse 2.0; Global Venturing, which says it spun out of Alphabet in 2025). The site links the LinkedIn page company/gradient-ventures and the X handle GradientVC, and press and portfolio pages (TechCrunch, Crunchbase News, BackOps, TNW) write 'Gradient Ventures'. EDGAR lists Gradient Fund V LP (CIK 2064254, San Francisco), whose Form D text contains 'GRDNT'. Ruled out: other EDGAR filers named Gradient that are not tied to gradient.com or GRDNT (Gradient Partners, L.P.; Gradient Europe Fund LP; Gradient Ascent Fund 0, LP; Gradient Ridge Onshore/Offshore funds; Forte Gradient LLC) and operating companies named Gradient (Gradient Labs, Gradient Health, gradient A.I. Corp., Gradient X). Recorded as type vc, not cvc: the 2026 sources describe it as independent and partner-owned, with Google as one LP among outside LPs.

thesis_text.value: Pre-seed and seed fund for AI founders, set up by Google in 2017 and now independent, that aims to write the first institutional check. Focus: AI-native B2B software, AI agents that reshape work, the AI developer stack, real-world AI (biology, materials, robotics, compute) and open-source, small-model and hybrid-compute plays; it avoids foundation-model contenders.

open_items: Check size: not stated on gradient.com (home, team, portfolio, Fund 5 post) or in Fortune, Pulse 2.0 or Global Venturing.

No public application form: the footer 'Founder Portal' (gradient.com/founders/) returns 401 (login required). Cold inbound recorded 'yes' from the Fund 5 post's 'Reach out'. Nothing found on requiring a US entity or on investing in Indian founders; the portfolio includes Latin American, Canadian and European companies.

Funds 1-4: exist by implication (Fund 5 is the 'fifth fund'; 'nearly $1.2 billion across five funds' per Pulse 2.0 and Global Venturing; Google was the sole LP of the first fund) but sizes and dates are undisclosed (Fortune: 'Gradient declined to disclose previous fund sizes'). Roughly $980M across Funds 1-4 is arithmetic, not reported.

SEC EDGAR: the efts search index answered with the declared User-Agent, but sec.gov Archives refused it (403), so the Gradient Fund V LP Form D (filed 2025-06-24, amended 2026-06-16) was not read; amount sold and first-sale date unknown. A Form D for 'GRDNT OPPT I LLC a Series of GRDNT MSTR LLC' (Claymont, DE, 2026-05-07) matches the GRDNT name but its link to Gradient is unconfirmed; not recorded as a fund.
HQ city from Global Venturing ('Based in San Francisco') and the Fund V LP's EDGAR business location; no street address on gradient.com (the privacy page names GRDNT LLC only).
Partner focus_sectors are inferred from the deal posts each partner wrote on gradient.com; the team page gives titles only and links no partner LinkedIn profiles.

Company websites for Arga Labs and Fazeshift come from gradient.com/portfolio, not the round pages; Feather's US base is inferred from TechCrunch calling it 'the only U.S. startup developing a modular humanoid platform'.

Rounds not recorded: Mastra $22M Series A (Spark Capital lead; Mastra's post does not name Gradient); Respan, Firstwork and Clarify posts give no round terms; Rivio (AI procurement) found only on database-style pages; Tamarack (mill software) has no round page; Axios Pro items linked from gradient.com/news (Collective $100M, Pathfinder $12M Series A, Sava $10M seed, Axle $17.5M, Hostie $12M, Enzo Health $20M, Spade $40M) not fetched (subscriber pages); Vera Health $28.5M Series A, Patlytics $40M, Polyphron, Quantro and Helical not checked.
